dimensions.label: Legality
dimensions.definition: Defensible route for the initial crypto-derivatives entry (US equities gated separately)

dimensions.label: Clarity
dimensions.definition: A usable licensing path exists today

rubric.note: Screening score identifies candidates. It does NOT set the entry sequence — adaptation cost and execution feasibility do (see sequencing_weights below). This is the deck's own 'SCORE ≠ SEQUENCE' finding (slide 6) and is the single most important thing this tool must preserve.

base.note: the exact weights printed on slide 4

regulation_heavy.note: slide 4 footnote says the top 3 were stress-tested under a 'regulation-heavy' weighting but doesn't print the numbers — this is a reconstruction. Replace with your working notes if you kept the real ones.

sequencing_weights.note: Tuned so the engine's combined priority index reproduces the deck's own sequence (Dubai 1st, Brazil 2nd, Indonesia 3rd) despite Brazil having the highest raw screening score. See src/engine/sequencing.ts:recommendedSequence(). Retune if adaptation_cost/execution_dependency estimates below change.

markets.name: Brazil
markets.market_signal: B3 dated futures · 148M+ Pix users · SPSAV regime live

deep_dive.qualifies_reason: Largest commercial base on the shortlist — 148M+ Pix users; VASP regime now live.
deep_dive.crypto_route: BCB Res. 519-521/2025 create the SPSAV licence; crypto futures trade on B3 via a licensed intermediary — dated contracts, not perpetuals.
deep_dive.equities_route: CVM-regulated; local introducing-broker model has precedent. MochaTrade's route requires confirmation.
deep_dive.required_product_changes: Rebuild perpetuals as dated futures; Pix funding and withdrawal; identify wallet owners on self-custody transfers.
deep_dive.capital_and_licensing: Partner with, or register as, a BCB-authorised SPSAV (own licence: BCB capital tiers apply). Filing window for existing operators closes 30 Oct 2026.
deep_dive.commercial_adoption: Pix at national scale; dated futures change the perpetuals UX — validate demand before full rollout.

sequence.label: Commercial scale
sequence.rationale: Largest base on the shortlist (148M+ Pix users) — worth the rebuild, so filing starts while Dubai is in build.
sequence.if_delayed: Hold at US equities until B3 access and product classification are confirmed.

markets.adaptation_execution_rationale: Medium adaptation cost: full product rebuild (perpetuals -> dated futures) but a well-precedented introducing-broker/SPSAV route, no new local exchange partner beyond B3 access.

markets.name: Dubai (UAE)

deep_dive.qualifies_reason: Only rulebook that names retail perpetuals explicitly; dollar-pegged AED, no capital controls.
deep_dive.crypto_route: VARA Exchange Services Rulebook, Part V (ETD, 31 Mar 2026): perpetuals permitted at <=5x retail leverage, 20% minimum margin, suitability checks.
deep_dive.equities_route: Outside VARA's remit — separate securities-brokerage licence (SCA or DFSA/DIFC). Route requires confirmation.
deep_dive.required_product_changes: Cap leverage at 5x (vs. higher India multiples); suitability onboarding. Less revenue per user, clearer legal route.
deep_dive.capital_and_licensing: AED 800k+ base capital (approx. US$0.2M), plus VARA custody/overhead add-ons. ETD authorisation is sequential to the base licence.
deep_dive.commercial_adoption: Small market: proves product and compliance, not volume. Aani instant rail; demand is a hypothesis to test.

sequence.label: Product fit
sequence.rationale: Only market where retail perpetuals are explicitly legal — the cheapest proof the product works under regulation.

markets.adaptation_execution_rationale: Lowest adaptation cost and execution dependency: closest product fit (perpetuals already explicit), lowest capital, direct licence (no local partner required).

markets.name: Indonesia
markets.market_signal: 22.9M accounts · perpetuals live via licensed traders

deep_dive.qualifies_reason: 22.9M crypto accounts (OJK, Jul 2026); perpetuals already live on CFX through licensed traders.
deep_dive.crypto_route: Partner with a licensed physical crypto trader (Pedagang / PAKD) routing derivatives through CFX under POJK 23/2025. Partner terms require confirmation.
deep_dive.equities_route: US-stock access has local precedent via licensed intermediaries; MochaTrade's route requires confirmation.
deep_dive.required_product_changes: Cannot operate as a single app: partner-fronted onboarding; settlement moves from UPI to QRIS / BI-FAST via a licensed payment partner.
deep_dive.capital_and_licensing: Own Pedagang licence needs Rp100bn minimum capital (exchange tier up to Rp1tn) — deferred; enter partner-led.
deep_dive.commercial_adoption: Large regulated ecosystem — Rp3.41tn monthly derivatives value (OJK, Jul 2026) — but the highest localisation burden.

sequence.label: Localisation
sequence.rationale: Strong demand (22.9M accounts) but two partners, new rails, new language — highest execution dependency.

markets.adaptation_execution_rationale: Highest adaptation cost and execution dependency: not a single-app model, needs partner-fronted onboarding plus a new payment rail (QRIS/BI-FAST) and new language.

markets.name: Philippines
markets.market_signal: BSP moratorium · SEC route · Php100M capital
markets.screened_out_reason: BSP moratorium on new virtual-asset-service-provider licences plus a Php100M capital bar keep legality and licence scores low despite real demand.

markets.name: Nigeria
markets.market_signal: Draft SEC rules · resident CEO · N2B capital
markets.screened_out_reason: Rules are still in draft, require a resident CEO and N2B capital — clarity and FX/custody too weak to clear.

markets.name: Pakistan
markets.market_signal: Licensing opened Aug 2026 · untested · rupee-only accounts
markets.screened_out_reason: Licensing regime opened only in Aug 2026 and is untested; rupee-only accounts add FX friction.

markets.name: Thailand
markets.screened_out_reason: The relevant access route is still a proposal (Aug 2026 SEC consultation), not a rule teams can file against.

markets.name: South Africa
markets.market_signal: 310 CASPs licensed · draft rule blocks self-custody transfers
markets.screened_out_reason: A draft Capital Flow Management Regulation would block self-custody inflows outright — the lowest FX/custody score on the board.

markets.name: Vietnam
markets.screened_out_reason: Ranks #4 globally in crypto adoption but the pilot needs ~US$380M capital and caps foreign ownership at 49% — legality and licence both fail.
